claim_stubs.name: Single-Column Form Layout
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Use one vertical stack for fields. Allow narrow exceptions only for tightly coupled micro-fields (e.g., city/state/ZIP).
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Layout audit: consecutive unrelated inputs share similar vertical positions outside allowed micro-groups.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Checkout, signup, lead forms, most consumer forms.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Expert dense enterprise forms with trained users; tightly coupled date/name parts.

claim_stubs.name: Guest Checkout Prominence
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: On account gate step, present Guest Checkout as equal/greater visual weight than Sign in / Create account.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Checkout entry audit: guest path missing, below fold, or weaker than login.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: B2B portals requiring authenticated purchasing by policy.

claim_stubs.name: Error Prevention and Fault Tolerance
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Prefer constraints/masks and field-level validation after completion. Never wipe the form on failure. Messages must be specific and programmatically associated.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Submit-only validation with page reload; cleared fields; color-only errors.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Account, checkout, payment, and high-stakes forms.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Validate-on-each-keystroke before the user finishes typing.

claim_stubs.name: ISO 9241-110 Self-Descriptiveness
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Visible labels, explained states, and actionable errors. Prefer persistent labels over placeholder-only fields; icon-only controls need accessible names.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Audit controls for missing accessible names; placeholder-only fields; opaque errors.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Universally conventional icons may use short names if the accessibility tree is complete.

claim_stubs.name: ISO 9241-110 Suitability for the Task
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Show only controls/info needed for the current task; minimize steps for common paths; hide advanced options until needed.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: For a screen, mark elements not supporting the primary task; if a large share is irrelevant, fail.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Task-focused flows: forms, checkout, setup wizards.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Command centers / multi-goal dashboards where breadth is the task.

claim_stubs.name: Fogg Behavior Model (B=MAP)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Diagnose failed CTAs/onboarding by testing Prompt visibility/timing, Ability (friction), and Motivation (value clarity). Prefer raising Ability before spamming prompts.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: High exposure + low conversion: check if prompt is hidden, task is hard, or value is unclear.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Conversion CTAs, onboarding, notifications, habit loops.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Passive reading surfaces; automated backend processes; manipulative dark patterns.

claim_stubs.name: WCAG Contrast (Minimum)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Compute relative luminance of foreground/background pairs. Fail if normal text < 4.5:1 or large text (≈18pt+/14pt bold) < 3:1. Prefer semantic tokens that encode compliant pairs.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Automated contrast checkers (axe, WAVE, WebAIM) plus sampling computed styles on text over images/gradients.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: All meaningful text and images of text, including form labels and error copy.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Decorative text, inactive/disabled components, incidental logotypes as allowed by WCAG.

conflict_pairs.decision_hint: One large primary CTA; disclose secondary options. Never below WCAG target floor.
